verdict.rationale: The only non-US signal is a one-line 'ESS reporting' item on the pricing page (an employee share scheme reporting feature, commonly an Australian regime) and bare/nominee trust support. All documented valuation capability is the US 409A, and nothing mentions UK HMRC/EMI valuations or country-specific option plan templates. missing for 10: UK HMRC/EMI valuation support, country-specific option plan types beyond NSO/ISO, documentation explaining what ESS reporting covers and for which jurisdictions, independent corroboration.
